en.html: To Ichijou Ayane. To that girl.

ja.html:

en.html:
From one blind spot to the next, I ran the shortest possible route. Still, reaching in time was impossible.

Before I cut the power, that cannon would strike Ichijou.

What it could do, my own body knew very well. Her hastily made armour could not endure it. Not one chance in ten crore.

She would die.

ja.html:
敵騎の死角から死角へ抜ける、最短の距離を駆ける。
　決して間に合わない。

　俺が電力源を断つ前に。
　あの砲は一条を襲う。

　その威力は身に染みて知っている。
　急造の甲鉄しか持たぬ一条が耐え抜ける可能性は、
億に一つも無い。

　彼女は死ぬ。

en.html:
Through a break in the trees, for a moment I saw her. Death in front of her—and still that girl would not break.

She could not see me. Our eyes did not meet.

Yet Ichijou was looking at me.

Trust was there, in her eyes.

I would not come to save her. That she trusted. I would abandon her. On that also, full faith.

Step on her body, make it my foothold, and free the people inside the monster. She trusted me to do that. That alone. Without any doubt.
en.text:
Through a break in the trees, for a moment I saw her. Death in front of her—and still that girl would not break.

She could not see me. Our eyes did not meet.

Yet Ichijou was looking at me.

Trust was there, in her eyes.

I would not come to save her. That she trusted. I would abandon her. On that also, full faith.

Step on her body, make it my foothold, and free the people inside the monster. She trusted me to do that. That alone. Without any doubt.

ja.html:
木々の切れ目に束の間、その姿を見た。
　死を前にして――なお挫折せぬ少女。

　彼女から俺の姿は見えない。
　俺と彼女の視線は重ならない。

　しかし一条は俺を見ていた。

　その<ruby>眸<rt>ひとみ</rt></ruby>が、俺を信頼していた。

　自分を助けになど来ないことを信じていた。
　見捨ててくれることを信じていた。

　自分の死骸を踏みつけ、踏み台にして、怪物に囚わ
れた人々を救ってくれることを、ただ<ruby>偏<rt>ひとえ</rt></ruby>に信じていた。

en.html:
I tore my eyes away and ran. At least witness her last moment—that useless wish also would betray what she had entrusted to me. I knew it.

Ahead only. Look ahead and move.
Go on, cutting the truth into my heart as I went.

Again. With these hands, an innocent person sacrificed. Again.

眼を引き離して、駆ける。
　せめて最期を見届けてやりたい――そんな無駄さえ
彼女の誠心を裏切るものだと知って。

　前だけを見据えて進む。
　真実を胸に刻みながら進む。

　この手が<ruby>また<rt>・・</rt></ruby>罪なき人を犠牲にした、その真実を。

No more hiding required. Out of the woods, straight toward the target.

　もはや身を隠す必要もない。
